technique_name: In a short paragraph, explain how a blockchain works.
description: A blockchain is a distributed ledger technology that enables the recording, tracing and approval of digital data in a secure, decentralized manner. It is made up of individual blocks, each containing a cryptographic hash of the previous block, a timestamp and transaction data. This data is then distributed among multiple computers on the network, making it impossible to manipulate or tamper with.
